name: Post 1
description: Post 1 was a Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It fought at the Second Battle of Javin. Carrying a small amount of equipment that was presumably stolen from Outpost D-34, the shuttle, along with Post 2, was destroyed by the frigate Fogger.

data.name: Post 1
armament: Taim & Bak KX5 laser cannons (3; forward)
Taim & Bak H9 dual turbolaser (1; aft turret)
